lines.en: : Shooo......whyy’dwe come heeere again?...
: Fuck! This isn’t how it was supposed to-
: Go away! Nobody asked you, mission text!
: Aaaand you! Penis guy! Why’s your alcoholllltolerance gotta be higher’an ours?! Huh?! Thisall parta your plan?!
: Haven’t you only had like two beers?
: I’M STILL NEW TO DRINKING! YOUGUYSS GOTTA HEAD SSSTARTT!!!
: Senpaaaaai...lessssssgo...make out behind the bar....I gotta...Igotta somethin’ I wanna ashkkk you...
: SSHHHH! IMANI NO! ISSSSGOTTA BE A SHHECRET!!
: Osako, you don’t happen to know what’s going on here, do you?
: Well, Akira, if I didn’t know any better, I’d think the two of them came here wanting to get you extremely drunk to make you confess to something.
: And boy, do I sure wonder what that could possibly be.
: Is that true, guys?
: TELLUSSHHH YOUR INTENTIONS, BUCKO!!!
: SHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!! WE GOTTA PLAYIT COOLLLL! WE GOTTAWAIT FOR’M T...DRINK MORE!
: I’m kind of glad Wakana wasn’t able to come tonight. It’s literally impossible to get her drunk and she’d be the ace their team needs.
: Does that imply you’re on mine?
: Not willingly. You’re like the guy who was randomly chosen to select teams for dodgeball in gym class and I was the obvious first choice who now has to pretend to want to be here.
: In that case, as the captain of this team, I command you to use your karate on them to make them go away.
: Sorry, I only do knife karate now.
: You do what?
: LESHHHPLAY TRUTHOR DARE!
: NAAAHHHHH! LESSSPLAY TRUTH OR TRUTH! I PICK TRUTH! SOMEBODYYYYASK ME SOMETHING!
: Ohhh I’ll do it! I gotta queshun forya, Rika-channnn. D’ya think I’m prettttyyyyyyy?
: Yerrrfine, I guess...kinda needy though’n I jsht ain’tshurr I’mreadyy for that...
: You remember that time we kissssedd???
: Not really...didthat even happen?
: SenpaaaiiiiiiI! Rika’sbein’ mean to me again! Make Osako do’er karate or somethin’!
: I feel like I’m forgettin’ why I’m-
: Waitno! Akira! Truth or d...truth! Yagotta pick one!
: Dare.
: Idare you to ffffffinger me! Betcha won’t! Betche’r...hic...scaaaaaared!
: We’renottt...doin’ dares! Yagotta...tell a truth!
: Can’t I just finger Imani instead? If anything, it might help sober her up so you guys can continue your mission without making yourselves look like drunken psychopaths.
: NO! Iffyer gonna finger her yagotta finger all of us! S’only fair...
: Are lesbians allowed to do hand stuff with guys or is that against the lesbian rules?
: Is that a real question?
: I’m just trying to be fair and impartial here if I’m going to be fingering all of you.
: No, Akira. Lesbians don’t normally do “hand stuff” with guys.
: Just sometimes?
: As a straight man, what would you do if some guy shoved his hand down your pants?
: Not enjoy it, but probably go along with it anyway due to years of conditioning and a self-esteem so terrible that it rivals even yours.
: Okay. Well, if you shove your hand down my pants, I will be far less accepting and show you firsthand what knife karate is.
: I might just have to find out now.
: WAITAMINUTE! Senpaiiii! Y’didn’t give us a truth yet! Yagotta do that ory’ll...loseshttthe game!
: You haven’t even asked me anything. Just what do you want me to say?
: Doyoouuu like teenage girls? And if weeeewere teenage girls, would you fuck us? I bet you wooooould!
: Thasstoo direct! Yagotta be more subtle’n that!
: Lesshhsjust see how’e answers! Maybe heeee is drunk! Arent’cha, Senpai?
: Extremely drunk. But even at the height of my inebriation, I know it is wrong to sleep with teenage girls and could never bring myself to even fantasize about such a thing.
: Thnwhy’d ya getshhoo weird when I put on the uniform for you, huh? HUH?! Y’saida buncha crazy stuff!
: You made her wear a school uniform for you? Are you really that sick, Akira?
: Oh, I’m sorry, Osako. If Wakana wore a school uniform for you, would you tell her to put her normal clothes back on and that she went too far?
: Well...no. But you clearly misunderstand our sexual dynamic if you don’t think I would be the one wearing the school uniform in that scenario.
: I think you should both wear school uniforms and then send me videos of what you do to each other. That’s what real friends would do.
: Maybbbeee he’s just inta lesbians? Him and Osakkoo’re...really hittin’ it off alluva sudden, ain’t they?
: Senpaaaaai! I like girls too! Y’still like me, right????
: Imani! We’re supposed to be finding out if he wants to fuck my daughter, not you!
: Who’s prettierrr?! Me or Rin?!
: Ahh, so that’s what’s going on here. Rin said something that made you suspicious of me and now you’re trying to get me to confess to something that never happened?
: NUH-UH! Sheeee flatout TOLD me y’aint don’e anything! But that don’t mean you don’t wanna! Now, she won’t give up!
: Oh, good. So there are still some survivors out there. And here I was worried that the entirety of your former class had fallen victim to you by now.
: I’d tell you to watch what you’re saying if these two weren’t so drunk that they’ll likely never even remember this conversation.
: Why not just tell them, then? It’ll feel good to get things off your chest, won’t it? Then I won’t feel like I’m harboring a fugitive either.
: Not chancing it. Too busy being an upstanding, sexually normal citizen. I love adult women.
: We ain’t penetratin’ that defense, Rika...I think Senpai’s innoshent!
: That’s only cause’ya want him to be!
: Waittt, so you WANT him to bone your daughter?! Ew! Bad Rika!
: No! Thassnot what I said! Y’just decided he was innoshent beforewe even gottado the inveshhtigation! We need more truths! Imani! Yougo! Truthor truth?!
: Dare! I dare me to get married to Senpai!
: DAAAAHH DAH DA-DAAAA! I do. Thosewere the wedding bells...uhh...song...anyway, honeymoon time! Takey’r pants off, big guy. I got somethin’ for ya.
: Imani’sshh clearly broken! Time for another truth, Akira! What kind’a girls you even like, huh? Not even countin’ the ages. Obvioushly cause we don’t sus...pectya of nothin’....
: Large, dominant women with massive breasts. The kind that can’t be confused for anyone under the age of eighteen.
: Y’didn’t say “I do” yet. D’ya not wanna marry me or somethin’?
: If I marry you right now, will you join my dodgeball team and combat Rika with us?
: Nuh-uh! Imani’s my best-
: Yeah! Lesssget’er!
: Then, I do.
: Rikaaaaaa! I got married!
: Oh my god! Congratulations! I’m so happy for-
: Aaaay! Hold on! You’re just tryin’ to pull the eyes over my wool!
: I can’t wait to tell my dad...he’s gonna be ssho happy issnot a girl...
: Teenagers! What about ‘em?!
: They’re exhausting. And completely irrelevant to the adult conversation we are having right now. Shouldn’t you maybe have a glass of water or something?
: Shouldn’t ya maybe not do whatever I think you’re doin’?!
: Do you even know what you think I’m doing?
: No, caushhhYOU ain’t bein’ truthful!
: My head hurts.
: Okay, my turn. Rika — truth or truth?
: Dare! Everybody else’s doin’it so I’M gonna too!
: Truth it is. Do you think I’m sleeping with any of the students?
: I DON’T KNOW! THASS’WHAT I’M- wait, no! You ain’t gonna trick me! We’re just playin’ a game!
: Imani, do you think I’m sleeping with any of the students?
: I think my head hurts.
: But alssooooo, you ain’t doin’ yerself any favors in makin’ me think you’re not, Senpai.
: I kiiiiiinda get it, though. Buncha horny girls walkin’ around lookin’ for Mr. Johnson. Probably haaaaard to say no, huh? Speshully whenya know where he liiiiives.
: Know I’d struggle if I were you. Anybody would. Attention’s nice. Bein’ wanted is nice. But’cha gotta draw the line where a line needs to go, right? My head hurts.
: Yeah, you’ve mentioned that a few times. New question, though — why try getting me drunk if you wanted to talk about this?
: Talk about what? What’re we doin’ again? I forget.
: Hey, when’s trivia start? It’s tonight, ain’t it? I wanna play a game!
: This has to be the least effective interrogation that has ever happened. They’re like one drink away from being convinced that they’re the bad guys here.
: Another round please, bartender. Don’t worry, they’re not driving.
: Y’know, Senpai...you can talk to me about anything if you want...
: We’re best friends, right? And even if you’ve done some bad stuff, that don’t mean you can’t be forgiven for it. God always forgives. So us regular people should too, right?
: Imani, you’re-
: I fuckin’ love you, man. Y’ain’t gotta keep secrets from me. Shhoowhynot juss spill the beans already? Kinda did already. I’s jusss too busy gettin’ railed’ta realllyyyy think about it.
: Osako, help. She’s starting to be kind of coherent and I’m going to crack.
: Hey, don’t look at me. I want you to crack. Being the only one in our group who knows stuff is exhausting. My job gets way easier if someone you’re actively sleeping with also knows.
: Knows what?...
: She mean what I think she means, Senpai?
: Y’aint gotta say who. Y’aint gotta even say if anythin’ happened. Just say what kinda girls you really like. I ain’t gonna judge.
: My head hurts.
: Fine. You win.
: I have a hard time saying no to you anyway. I just wish you approached this a...little differently?
: Confronting someone about concerns is admirable or whatever, but when you’re trying to deceive them into giving you the information you want, it’s just...
: My head really hurts. I’m, like...dizzy.
: It’s just not what I’d expect from you, Imani. Rika, sure. But you’re not the type to really-
: Brlgh?!...
: Wait, you’re not going to throw up, are you? Please don’t.
: Talk about convenient timing. It’s like a sign from the heavens that maybe confessing this to rational people is a bad idea.
: Mmmngh?! Mmmgh??!?!
: Can you not even make it to the-
: BLGHEHGFHRGHRGHGRLLHGHGMMGNHGH!!!!!!
: ...bathroom.
: There, there...let it all out...it happens to the best of us...
: Easy for you to say. You’re not the one being puked on.
: Oh, Akira. When’d you get here?
: Oh god...
: There’s more...
